02756 Chariyph {khaw-reef'}

源自 02778; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本- Hariph 2; 2

哈拉 = "拔出"
1)跟隨所羅巴伯被擄歸回的一個家族領袖 ( #尼7:24|)
2)與尼希米立約的一個人民領袖( #尼10:19|)
record.edic_text:
02756 Chariyph {khaw-reef'}

from 02778;; n pr m

AV - Hariph 2; 2

Hariph = "a plucking off"
1) head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel
2) a head of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
